name: ARGO
summary: ARGO is the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration's proposed next-generation large liquid-argon observatory, succeeding DEAP and DarkSide. ARGOlite is a related technology-prototype programme.
detection_principle: A proposed large single-phase liquid-argon target would use underground argon with low 39Ar activity and scintillation pulse-shape discrimination to search for nuclear recoils, alongside neutrino physics.

sites.name: SNOLAB
sites.location: Underground laboratory in the Creighton mine, Sudbury, Ontario

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The SNOLAB 2025 conference abstract explicitly describes a proposal, with deployment planned at SNOLAB.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
